name: Pane
text: Pane: Hold—why default to Lighthouse in CI mode when the repo’s own `package.json` doesn’t list it as a dependency? That’s a hidden risk: the audit will fail silently if `npx lighthouse` isn’t globally available or pinned in the project’s toolchain. Demand proof the team has verified Lighthouse’s presence in the CI matrix before we waste cycles on a phantom dependency.
